messages.subject: Adrian Vholes — agreed exit
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, the Board wants to move quickly on Adrian's departure. He's told Iqbal he's going to Cedarwell, which makes the covenants a live issue. Can you send your engagement terms and let us know what you need from us? We have his 2019 service agreement to hand.

Thanks,
Lorna

Lorna Keane
Chief Operating Officer
Ashbourne Healthcare Group
